parameters.query: SELECT id, name, phone_number, status, sms_sent, sms_date, category, registrar, registration_date, branch_id FROM records WHERE LOWER(TRIM(status)) = 'ready' AND LOWER(COALESCE(sms_sent::text, '')) NOT IN ('true', 't', 'yes', 'y', '1', 'sent', 'success') AND phone_number IS NOT NULL AND TRIM(phone_number) <> '' ORDER BY registration_date DESC NULLS LAST, id DESC LIMIT 5;

parameters.jsCode: const items = $input.all(); const preview = []; for (const item of items) { const name = String(item.json.name ?? 'customer').trim(); const phone = String(item.json.phone_number ?? '').trim(); const message = `Hello ${name || 'customer'}, your case is ready. Please visit the office. Thank you.`; preview.push({ json: { ...item.json, dry_run: true, sms_preview: message, sms_to: phone, sms_sent_candidate: false } }); } return preview;
